Landed inside the equivalence class. A real image exists, is published where an outsider can fetch it, and was demonstrated booting: v0.1.1-alpha.2 carries e46c4060215b3803416996c479db77ecc060b6a66650722ffcb3e0fa641ba211, pulled from ghcr.io onto a machine that did not build it and booted there to THERMITE_SUCCESS gate=boot-smp-v1. All five witnesses are material. The telos names physical hardware as well; nothing has left QEMU, so that half is untouched.
